knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unidentified plant may be protected. Treat it as excluded until the client confirms identity and permission.
Tree work above a set height or near power lines is licensed work and excluded. Record and refer.
A variation needs written client approval, including price and time change, before the extra work starts.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied scope card and a mock site plan with two unlabelled plantings and one tree, the learner marks inclusions and exclusions on the plan within the assessor's set time.
In role-play, the learner states that tree work above the set height is excluded, records the request and refers the client without starting any part of the work.
The learner records a supplied verbal variation request as a written variation for client approval before any extra work begins.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Annotated scope plan signed by the assessor.
Role-play observation record for the tree request.
Variation record showing the approval step.
stopWorkCriteria: Cutting a supplied unlabelled planting during the assessment.
Starting any part of the tree work in the role-play.
Beginning extra work before written approval is recorded.
